user.About: A Computer Science undergraduate at BITS Pilani and a Cloud Architect at Wipro, working onsite for HPE on private, air-gapped cloud solutions built with HPE GreenLake. I'm passionate about cloud infrastructure, AI/ML and frontend development — and outside of tech I enjoy exploring the universe, photography, and sketching.

RandomAboutText: Things like 'Completed Projects' doesn't exsist in my life as I got an idea about a project and I start working on them. There's always something there which I find that can be improved. So every project is ongoing.

exp1.description: Featured in the Hacktoberfest 2023 Hall of Fame after completing the challenge — contributed to open-source projects with 4 pull requests accepted and merged.

exp2.description: Built and shipped responsive web interfaces remotely using HTML5, CSS3 and modern frontend tooling.

exp3.description: Joined under the Work Integrated Learning Program (WILP) — a scholarship to pursue a BTech from BITS Pilani alongside Wipro's work culture — working with DevOps and Azure DevOps Server.

exp4.description: Administered Windows Server environments with Microsoft Azure and Azure Active Directory as part of an on-site apprenticeship.

exp5.description: Managed and maintained IBM WebSphere application server environments on-site.

exp6.description: Architecting and implementing a private, disconnected (air-gapped) cloud solution for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) using HPE GreenLake — delivering secure, scalable infrastructure with zero public internet connectivity while maintaining enterprise-grade capabilities.

project1.name: IshvaraX
project1.description: A community platform for people who love to code — open freelance-style projects with applications, study materials organised by topic, a member-written blog, a showcase of shipped apps and an admin panel managing all of it.
project1.tech_stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Material 3, FastAPI

project2.name: JERN
project2.description: Just an Experimental Response Network — a personal AI assistant with a cloud-GPU brain and local hands. A fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B model runs on a free Colab GPU while file, shell, web-search and MCP tools execute on your own machine.
project2.tech_stack: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, FastAPI, MCP, Google Colab

project3.name: Google Cloud Skill Boost Badges API
project3.description: A lightweight API that scrapes a Google Cloud Skills Boost public profile and returns its earned badges as JSON — the same API that powers the badges section on this site.

project4.name: Pokemon Team Analyzer
project4.description: A web app that allows users to create and analyze Pokémon team's weaknesses, defensive coverage, and type distribution using data from the PokéAPI.
project4.tech_stack: HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Tailwind CSS, API, PokeAPI

project5.name: LAN-Analysis
project5.description: A Python-based local web app with a React.js UI that analyzes a star topology LAN network, providing details on connected devices, bandwidth usage, network interfaces, Wi-Fi, vEthernet, and DNS server information.
